description.text: Root files for the first create, including LICENSE from the project license. version.json is not a checkbox here; choose Repository version.json on a first create to add it. Visual Studio requires at least one value; choose None when adding another library to the same repository.

Puts each .slnx next to that library's notes under src/sln/{name}/ so multiple libraries do not share one directory. Visual Studio also creates a root .slnx; close Visual Studio, open the src/sln solution, and delete the extra root .slnx.
Checked values write explicit C# and debug properties on the class library, tests, and benchmark. XML documentation is library-only. Uncheck one to write the alternative.

Optional extra package. Default Off keeps VersionPrefix in the library project. Repository version.json is written on a first create (root items plus Repository). Later libraries keep Repository and choose None for root items.
Default MIT. Standard licenses set PackageLicenseExpression and keep License.txt on disk. Custom packs License.txt as the NuGet license file. The LICENSE file at repository root copies this license.

name.text: Code style rules for library project

description.text: Adds editor and analyzer rules beside the library project and applies them to that project in the IDE and on build. Test and benchmark projects are not affected.
